C9000304.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 304 (The Hilbert–Smith conjecture in every dimension.; papers: The Hilbert–Smith conjecture in every finite dimension; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.
C9000304.scope_note: The dependencies below are the manuscript-verification branch. A certified refutation would be a different successful audit route; none is asserted here.

M304_MAIN.statement: thm:main: every continuous Z_p action on a connected finite-dimensional manifold as specified has nonzero kernel.

M304_CHART_REDUCTION.statement: prop:chart-reduction produces a faithful orientation-preserving action on a connected invariant chart subset from a faithful manifold action.

M304_CONTRADICTION.statement: thm:contradiction obtains equal rational character parts of total 4u in a fixed denominator lattice, contradicting m>4L_d.

M304_CHARACTER_PACKAGE.statement: The action-derived integral character classes exist, are covariant and homotopy invariant, have the stated sum and equal parts, and the moved test has nonzero degree.
M304_CHARACTER_PACKAGE.scope_note: Sections 5-6 and the degree/test-moving inputs remain outside this bounded localization proof.

M304_SPHERE_LATTICE.statement: thm:sphere-lattice: the rational degree-d sphere group has the orientation line and its integral image lies in one fixed 2-power denominator lattice.

M304_SPHERE_RANK.statement: prop:sphere-rank gives the rational sphere splitting in every degree.

M304_GENERIC_SIGNATURE.statement: prop:generic-signature identifies the integral image on the semialgebraic rational orientation line with Z.

C304_BOUND.statement: Conditional refinement of thm:bounded-comparison: every sphere comparison has a two-sided 2^j-transfer, hence kernel and cokernel killed by 2^j, uniformly in the Witt degree.

C304_TRANSFER.statement: Natural dense-doubling squares carry a two-sided q-transfer to a two-sided 2q-transfer; an arbitrary abelian-group tower therefore has 2^j-transfers.
C304_TRANSFER.scope_note: Lean 4.31.0 compiled the universal group theorem with zero proof holes. Independent statement-fidelity review is still required.

C304_LOCALIZATION.statement: The full lem:cutoff, thm:germs, and prop:open-cover statements hold in the actual generated categories.

L304_CUTOFF.statement: lem:cutoff for every object of B_0(X), every closed K contained in open O, and arbitrary derived cone morphisms.

L304_SUPPORT.statement: prop:compact-support recognizes the open extension image, including arbitrary actual summands.

L304_GERMS.statement: thm:germs identifies all ordinary Verdier-quotient morphisms with ambient derived germs, including summand sources and roofs.

L304_OPEN_COVER.statement: prop:open-cover is fully faithful, exact, duality preserving, dense by actual summands, and compatible with P to T.

M304_CATEGORY_INPUTS.statement: The actual section-2 categories have compact support, full ambient derived Hom, actual summands, bounded reflexive duality, and fully faithful compactly supported open extension.

M304_HOMOTOPY_POINT.statement: thm:homotopy and lat:point-groups apply naturally to the possibly nonproper allowed pole-cover homotopies and give point and S^0 comparison isomorphisms.

M304_WITT_LOCALIZATION.statement: thm:witt-localization supplies natural integral long exact sequences for the ordinary quotients, in every shifted degree.

M304_DENSE_DOUBLING.statement: The explicit dense-doubling map is well defined, has both composites equal to 2, and is natural for exact duality-preserving comparison functors.
